ontology_source: Object Ontology v01 verified on SQLite v06; taxonomy reviewed v01.1

semantics.mutually_exclusive: Single gold label per fully specified supported task, using primary output contract and deterministic boundary rules.
semantics.not_statistical_independence: Independent intent categories means non-overlapping classification outcomes; execution methods and DB classes may be shared.
semantics.open_world_limit: No finite taxonomy guarantees complete coverage of all future natural-language questions. Out-of-scope and new requirements require governance/relabeling.
semantics.no_unsafe_clarify: Use CLARIFY only for genuinely missing or conflicting task target/metric/scope, not merely because two classes are involved.
semantics.no_fake_unsupported: If DB supports required columns but a method/template is missing, route the supported intent and flag CONTRACT_GAP, not UNSUPPORTED.

priority.result: REFUSE only on explicit disallowed actions or unauthorized access
UNSUPPORTED only if required information/system genuinely absent

priority.rule: Two or more independently requested primary outputs
priority.result: MULTI_OUTPUT_REPORT single label, decompose into validated subplans later
Exactly one atomic Intent by output anchor; dimensions/filters must NOT spawn extra labels

priority.rule: Method missing or cross-entity semantic contract unapproved
priority.result: Keep intent label, mark CONTRACT_GAP and block execution, rather than relabel question

critical_distinctions: Metric toàn hệ thống -> REVENUE_METRICS; metric GROUP BY từng Channel -> CHANNEL_ANALYTICS; GROUP BY Store -> STORE_ANALYTICS; GROUP BY Region -> REGIONAL_COVERAGE.
Thêm ORDER BY/RANK/TOP không đổi Intent nếu grain/đơn vị báo cáo chính giữ nguyên.
Tin nhắn -> CHAT_ACTIVITY; Order từ chat/agent -> ORDER_ATTRIBUTION.
Catalog flag is_in_stock -> PRODUCT_DISCOVERY; tồn theo snapshot -> INVENTORY_STATUS.
Promotion metadata -> PROMOTION_PROGRAM; danh sách SKU có promotion chính -> PRODUCT_DISCOVERY; giảm giá OrderItem -> PROMOTION_USAGE.
Paid Order GMV (dedup) -> REVENUE_METRICS; sự kiện giao dịch Payment -> PAYMENT_OPERATIONS.
Địa chỉ Customer đang lưu -> DELIVERY_ADDRESS; snapshot giao nhận của Shipment -> SHIPPING_LOGISTICS.
label_policy.cardinality_exclusivity_note: One classification label is guaranteed by the routing policy for annotated cases, not a universal language theorem.
classification_precedence_v01_1: Bắt đầu với REFUSE / UNSUPPORTED / CLARIFY khi lý do chính sách là thật và có bằng chứng.
Hai hoặc nhiều đầu ra độc lập => MULTI_OUTPUT_REPORT (không nhầm với GROUP BY).
Nếu một đầu ra: xác định answer grain (SKU, Supplier, Order, Payment, Channel, Store, Region...) và metric; ưu tiên GROUP BY result entity trước domain metric.
Nếu một dimension chỉ là FILTER cố định, giữ Intent theo metric/đối tượng đầu ra.
Thiếu Method/SQL contract => vẫn route Intent chính; ghi METHOD_CONTRACT_GAP và cấm execution chưa validate.
